a827b0d0-faa2-521f-b166-e13873b1da00.title: Finding an Entry of the Product of Two Matrices

e-4401.worked_solution:
Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ -5 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1\cdot 0+0\cdot (-1) & 1\cdot 1+0\cdot 2 \\ -5\cdot 0+1\cdot (-1) & -5\cdot 1+1\cdot 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & -3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}BA & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ -5 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0\cdot 1+1\cdot (-5) & 0\cdot 0+1\cdot 1 \\ -1\cdot 1+2\cdot (-5) & -1\cdot 0+2\cdot 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-5 & 1 \\ -11 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

**Watch out!** Notice that 

$$
AB \neq BA.
$$

Matrix multiplication is not **commutative**, meaning that when we switch the order of multiplication, we often get a different result (like we did in this example).

e-5255.knowledge_point: Finding an Entry of the Product of Two Matrices
e-5255.problem:
Let $Z=XY.$ What is the value of $z_{32}$, if

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ -2 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
e-5255.worked_solution:
Multiplying the $3$rd row in $X$ by the $2$nd column in $Y$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{z}_{32} & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =1\cdot (-1)+2\cdot 4+3\cdot (-2) \\  & =-1+8-6 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

e-4402.worked_solution:
Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 3 \\ 3 & -1 & -2 \\ -2 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & -2 \\ 1 & -2 & 4 \\ -3 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0+0-9 & -6+0-3 & 4+0+6 \\ 0-1+6 & 9+2+2 & -6-4-4 \\ 0+0+3 & -6+0+1 & 4+0-2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-9 & -9 & 10 \\ 5 & 13 & -14 \\ 3 & -5 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: Row-by-column multiplication gives the first and third rows (3+4, 2+2, 3+2)=(7,4,5). The second row is (0+0+4, 0-2+2, 0+0+2)=(4,0,2). This matches option c.

after.name: Question 11
after.worked_solution:
Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -2 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3+0+4 & 2+0+2 & 3+0+2 \\ 0-0+4 & 0-2+2 & 0-0+2 \\ 3+0+4 & 2+0+2 & 3+0+2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}7 & 4 & 5 \\ 4 & 0 & 2 \\ 7 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

after.worked_solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}BC & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 6 \\ -1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & -5 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1-6+6 & -4+3+0 & -5+12-18 \\ -1+0+2 & 4+0+0 & 5+0-6 \\ 0-2-2 & 0+1+0 & 0+4+6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -11 \\ 1 & 4 & -1 \\ -4 & 1 & 10\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

a
[1−2−1010−1419]
b
[1−1−1114−1−4110]
c

[1−2−1114−1−211]

[1−1−1014−1−411]

$$

Question 15
?

Find ST, if S=[1040−52202] and T=[3231−102−11].

a
[11−271321028]
b
[10−27−1321028]
c
[11−27−1321028]
d
[11−27−13210−28]
e
[11−27−132102−8]
Submit

decision.explanation: Row-column multiplication gives rows (3+8, 2-4, 3+4)=(11,-2,7), (-5+4, 5-2, 2)=(-1,3,2), and (6+4, 4-2, 6+2)=(10,2,8). This matches option c.

after.name: Question 15
after.worked_solution:
Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}ST & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & -5 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3+0+8 & 2+0-4 & 3+0+4 \\ 0-5+4 & 0+5-2 & 0-0+2 \\ 6+0+4 & 4-0-2 & 6+0+2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}11 & -2 & 7 \\ -1 & 3 & 2 \\ 10 & 2 & 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

ST=[1040−52202][3231−102−11]=[3+0+82+0−43+0+40−5+40+5−20−0+26+0+44−0−26+0+2]=[11−27−1321028].

content.worked_solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}ST & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & -5 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3+0+8 & 2+0-4 & 3+0+4 \\ 0-5+4 & 0+5-2 & 0-0+2 \\ 6+0+4 & 4-0-2 & 6+0+2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}11 & -2 & 7 \\ -1 & 3 & 2 \\ 10 & 2 & 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
